verdict.rationale: Vestd documents UK-specific schemes in depth: EMI scheme setup and grants, CSOPs, unapproved options and growth shares. It also offers a share valuation service and 409A valuations for UK companies granting options to US taxpayers, so it covers both UK schemes and cross-border valuation needs. Missing for 10: explicit evidence of HMRC valuation agreement (the valuations page is cited by title only), country-specific option plans beyond the UK and US, multi-entity support across jurisdictions, and independent corroboration.
